systems.tiers: National database held electronically by ANID; 'administrations', defined to include collectivites locales, may access its data for their aid programmes and may contribute to its updating, under conditions left to later regulation

note: Official gazette issue carrying two decrees: one on submarine cable authorisations, one creating the social registry. Local governments appear only in the decree's definition of 'administration' and in a cited decree on the public domain. A legal text: it states a permission to access a national database, not that any local government office is connected or works in it.
